citation.quote: Our Clinical Perfusion program is 5 semesters long and leads to a Master of Science degree.
The first year begins in the fall, and the program of study includes a minimum of 86.5 credit hours over 21 months (including summer).
Our program is a master's degree, and we're currently accepting about 20 students per year.
Cardiovascular Perfusion Program Director Bruce Searles, PhD, CCP, said the teaching space has been greatly transformed.
When students arrive, they spend the first two and a half semesters on campus.
SUNY Upstate’s Clinical Perfusion Program is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP).
